- If you see a rubber flap at the bottom of the tank (the **flapper**) and it’s open, try gently pushing it down to seal it. That will stop more water from going from the tank into the bowl.
- If you can, have someone else keep trying to tighten or slightly adjust the shutoff valve while you hold the float up.

2) Protect the area:
